title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement: If this path is to continue in the same pattern, then which sequence of arrows goes from point \(425\) to point \(427?\)

solutions.text:
The pattern repeats every \(4\) points, so the arrows leaving a point depend only on its remainder upon division by \(4.\)

Because \(425 = 4(106) + 1\) and \(427 = 4(106) + 3,\) the path from \(425\) to \(427\) looks just like the path from point \(1\) to point \(3\): from \(1\) it goes up to \(2,\) then right to \(3.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: The arrows repeat in a cycle of length \(4\), so a point’s outgoing arrows depend only on its remainder when divided by \(4\).
Since \(425\) and \(427\) leave remainders \(1\) and \(3\) when divided by \(4\), the arrows match those going from point \(1\) to point \(3\).
